description: One setting per call: change, a review action (refuse, remove; all_reads, restore; forward_authorization, drop_authorization: keyless, the app's Authorization); method and pattern alone request a rule; lock limits its reads. caller, window and calls set a call limit, remove_limit removes it.

approve_each_call.description: true: each call waits to be accepted.

calls.description: The number of calls allowed per window.

change.description: The action, as the review offers it.

lock.description: true: its reads limited to what was used in 30 days.

reason.description: Why this rule, in one sentence.

remove_limit.description: The limit to remove (its id, list_connections { view: "limits" }).

name: update_connection
title: Configure a connection
